g.text: 05 / AI ENGINEER GROWTH
Persist progress; make execution authority temporary
Arize separates durable issue history and skills from disposable sandboxes and bounded credentials.
DURABLE PROGRESS
Instrument enough to reconstruct
Retain the request, inputs, permissions, tools,
result, evaluator and relevant versions.
Distinguish a run summary from the ordered
trajectory. Trace agents modifying the system as
well as deployed agents, so a proposed repair has
evidence rather than only a confident explanation.
TEMPORARY EXECUTION
Separate progress from access
Issue history, useful skills and telemetry can
survive a sandbox failure; temporary credentials
and repository access should not survive by
default. A replacement run resumes from durable
state under newly checked authority. Persistence
of knowledge does not imply persistence of
permission.
Prove the change
Calibrate evaluators against human-labeled cases, replay a failure and inspect paired regressions. Proposed fixes
or PRs remain proposals until accountable review permits release. Prime Intellect’s learning progression makes
corrections an asset before pursuing routing or training optimizations.
Sources: Arize · Prime Intellect | Reviewed October 25, 2026
